Spring.name: Spring
Spring.tagline: Crisp greens, fragrant herbs & early seasonal berries
Spring.description: Spring brings a refreshing wave of crisp leafy vegetables, vibrant strawberries, tender avocados, and fragrant freshly cut herbs.

Summer.name: Summer
Summer.tagline: Sun-ripened tomatoes, sweet corn & juicy peaches
Summer.description: Warm summer sunshine produces the season's juiciest vine-ripened tomatoes, crisp cucumbers, sweet golden corn, and luscious orchard peaches.

Fall.name: Autumn / Fall
Fall.tagline: Harvest apples, sweet root vegetables & hearty squash
Fall.description: The autumn harvest features crisp orchard apples, sweet garden carrots, hearty farm potatoes, and nutrient-dense broccoli.

Winter.name: Winter
Winter.tagline: Tangy winter citrus, raw honey & rich country dairy
Winter.description: Cooler winter days bring antioxidant-rich citrus oranges, nourishing dairy milk, artisan cheese, and raw wildflower honey.
